Four uncropped full-body figures on one baseline at same height and scale in each option, ordered front, three-quarter at ~45 degrees, profile at 90 degrees, back at 180 degrees; entire hijab, head, both empty hands, legs and flats visible with margins; hands open and empty, no props held.

Eight head-and-shoulders portraits in locked prompt order in each option: neutral, warm smile, pure joy with broad open smile, thoughtful concentration, determined resolve, gentle surprise with parted lips, tender concern, playful mischief; each readable as itself. Option 1 joy and surprise read broadest; option 2 brows render slightly heavier; option 0 surprise reads softer but still distinct.
